exact_match.pdf.notes: Exact PO number, vendor, quantity, price, amount match.

price_mismatch.pdf.notes: Unit price and total exceed PO2009 amount beyond the 2% vendor tolerance.

quantity_mismatch.pdf.notes: Invoice bills 15 units against a PO2003 quantity of 12 (overbilling).

missing_po.pdf.notes: No PO number on invoice; unambiguously matched to PO2004 via vendor/item/amount similarity, but still routed to REVIEW for human confirmation since the PO reference itself was missing.

tax_total_mismatch.pdf.notes: Stated total (50000) does not equal subtotal+tax (52800); arithmetic check fails.

missing_date.pdf.notes: Invoice date missing; required-fields check fails even though amounts reconcile.

split_invoice_1.pdf.notes: First of 3 split invoices against PO2010 (40/100 man-days).

split_invoice_2.pdf.notes: Second of 3 split invoices against PO2010 (cumulative 70/100 man-days).

split_invoice_3.pdf.notes: Third of 3 split invoices against PO2010; cumulative reaches 100/100 man-days.

scanned_invoice.pdf.notes: Image-only PDF (no text layer). Expects REVIEW ('could not be reliably extracted') when Tesseract/Ollama are not configured; may extract successfully (and APPROVE) once they are.

unapproved_vendor.pdf.notes: Vendor 'Unknown Vendor' (V005) has status NOT_APPROVED in the vendor master.

different_layout.pdf.notes: Alternate invoice layout/label wording (template B) for the same underlying PO2008 match.

po_number_format_variant.pdf.notes: PO written as 'PO-2005'; normalizes to 'PO2005' for an exact level-1 match.

malformed_po.pdf.notes: PO reference given only as 'Ref: 2011' (malformed); matched to PO2011 via digits-only normalization (level 2).

bundled_line_items.pdf.notes: Invoice bundles PO2012's two separate line items (Pens Box + Notebooks Pack) into a single line; unit-price reconciliation fails at line-item level and is correctly routed to REVIEW rather than silently approved.
